segments.script: [EN: Warm up.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: My name is Nam.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tên tôi là Nam.] [EN: I will go.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi sẽ đi.] [EN: Airplane.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Máy bay.] [EN: Let's meet on Monday.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mình gặp thứ hai nha.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Gặp.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: To meet.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: You have heard these soft endings already. They make a request or statement warm and friendly, like adding okay? or ', alright?'. The southern favourite is] [VI_F: Nha.] [EN: a flat tone. See you tomorrow, okay?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mai gặp nha.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: A close cousin is] [VI_F: Nhé.] [EN: a high, rising tone, the same job. And very southern, very warm, is] [VI_F: Nghen.] [EN: Say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Nghen.] [EN: See you again, okay?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Hẹn gặp lại nghen.] [EN: You also know] [VI: đi,] [EN: which softens a suggestion into come on, let's. Let's go, come on.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Đi đi.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Drill. Add a warm okay to each. See you tomorrow, okay?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mai gặp nha.] [EN: Thank you, okay?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cảm ơn nha.] [EN: Wait a moment, okay?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chờ một chút nghen.] [EN: Now reverse.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: What do these soft endings do?] [VI_F: Nha?] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: They add a warm, friendly okay.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Đi đi.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Come on, let's go.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Mai mình gặp nha?] [VI_M: Dạ, được. Mười giờ nghen.] [VI_F: Ừ, hẹn gặp lại nha!] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now you try. Say, see you tomorrow, okay?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mai gặp nha.] [EN: Say, thank you, okay?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cảm ơn nha.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tomorrow you compare things. The preview word is] [VI: hơn] [EN: which means more, or -er.]
